notes.title: Kingdom's Deck v1.1.4 - AMD Compatibility Update
notes.content: This small update improves stability for players using AMD RX 7900 and RX 7600 graphics cards. Some users with these GPUs were experiencing crashes, and this patch should resolve those issues.

notes.title: Kingdom's Deck v1.1.3 - Difficulty Balance Update
notes.content:
Hey Lords and Ladies!

I’m back with a new patch for Kingdom’s Deck! After the last update tweaked the game’s difficulty, some of you mentioned that it ramps up too fast. I’ve been listening and your feedback is guiding me to find that perfect balance of fun and challenge. This patch smooths out difficulty spikes in certain levels and makes progression feel more gradual as you play.

[b]Endless Mode Progress[/b]

I’m working hard on the map for Endless Mode, and it’s coming together nicely! The update is on track, so stay tuned.

[b]Bug Fix[/b]

Tempest Mode: Fixed a bug that prevented players from completing Dunareth in Tempest Mode.

Thanks!

Your thoughts on the Steam forums and Discord are helping make this game better every day, thank you! Got ideas about difficulty or anything else? Drop them in the comments below or join the conversation in the forums. Loving the game? A quick Steam review would mean the world! More updates are coming soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2655590/Kingdoms_Deck/

notes.title: Kingdom's Deck v1.1.0 - Tempest Update
notes.content:
Hey Lords and Ladies!

It’s been just over a month since Kingdom’s Deck launched, and I’m super excited to share the first content update with you all! This one’s packed with two new game modes, some major balance changes, and a bunch of other goodies, all inspired by your awesome feedback.

[h2]New Game Modes[/h2]

I’ve added Tempest and Soul Rest, two new modes that are tougher than the average challenge. They’re built to push your skills to the limit, so get ready to test what you’ve learned! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786070/56730ec2e54e5e67574c856d896fc1ad2ffa1b4f.png[/img]

[h2]Game Balance[/h2]

A lot of you mentioned that the game can feel easy at higher levels. I hear you! I’ve reworked the balance across all existing levels, not to make them tough, but to keep things fair and fun. Enemies now scale their power based on your army’s strength, creating more balanced and thrilling battles. This update makes all modes more challenging and fair, but if you’re looking for a relaxed experience, Journey mode remains your go-to. 
Other Improvements

[list]
[*] Deck Cleanup: Leftover deck cards now auto-sell at the end of the day.
[*] New Achievements: Added new game achievements to chase.
[*] Tower Buffs: Increased the range of towers.
[*] Faster Workers: Workers now move quicker to get things done.
[*] Vortex Tower Boost: The Vortex Tower now deals more damage. 
[/list]

[h2]Trading Cards[/h2]

Great news! Steam approved Trading Cards for Kingdom’s Deck! You can now collect them on your Steam account.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786070/a7fb1e17eef35f2bb311ea9d06bbd7c784371b3c.png[/img]

[b]Bug Fix[/b]

Elite Archer: Fixed a bug where the Elite Archer would vanish when loading a saved game.

[b]What’s Next?[/b]

So many of you have asked for an infinite mode, and I’m already working on it! Endless waves of enemies test your defenses until they can take down your castle. It’s in development for a future update, so stay tuned!

[b]Big Thanks![/b]

Your comments on the Steam forums have been a game-changer for shaping the future of Kingdom’s Deck. I’m so grateful for your support! If you’re loving the game, a quick review on Steam would mean the world. Got ideas or feedback? [b]Drop them in the forums or swing by Discord to chat and share.[/b]

Forum link: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2655590/discussions/

More awesome updates are coming!

notes.title: Kingdom's Deck - v1.0.4 - Minor Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
Hey Lords and Ladies!

I’ve got a quick patch for you today. Some of you mentioned that card images weren’t showing up on certain Linux and Windows devices. This update fixes that. Thanks for letting me know about this issue. Got other bugs or ideas to share? Drop them in the comments below or on the discussion forums.

Oh, and I’m already working on the next content update! It’s going to [b]bring a new game mode[/b] and tweak the current difficulty balance based on all the great feedback you’ve shared.

Thanks for your support, new stuff is on the way! 

Ivan

notes.title: Kingdom's Deck - v1.0.3 - Balance & Optimization Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Lords and Ladies!

A new patch has arrived, and this one’s all about fine-tuning the balance of Kingdoms Deck. I’ve reading your feedback: some of you love the chill vibe of Standard mode, while others crave a tougher challenge. To give everyone what they want, I’ve unlocked Conqueror mode from the start, now it’s up to you to decide if you’re ready to take it on! I’ve also worked on other balance tweaks to make the game feel just right.

[b]Game Balance[/b]

Castle Range: The castle now attacks from a greater distance.
Armorer & Blacksmith Buffs: I’ve adjusted the buffs from the Armorer and Blacksmith.
Standard Mode Nights: Nighttime in Standard mode is now slightly tougher.
Event Rewards: Several events have had their rewards rebalanced for fairer payouts.
Builder Speed: The Builder now constructs a bit faster.
Islenor Enemies: Enemy balance in Islenor has been improved.
Crow of Shadows: This enemy now has less health, making fighting him more manageable.

[b]Optimization[/b]

DirectX 11 Priority: The game now prioritizes DirectX 11 to maximize compatibility and performance across all graphics cards.

Your feedback is what fuels the growth of Kingdoms Deck, so please share your thoughts on these changes in the comments here or on the discussion forums. Thanks for your support, more updates are coming soon!

Ivan

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2655590/Kingdoms_Deck/

notes.title: Kingdom's Deck - v1.0.2 - Performance Updates
notes.content:
Hi, Lords and Ladies!

It’s a new day, and I’ve got a new patch for you! This update is all about fixing bugs and making the game run better. Here’s what I’ve added in this one.

[b]Optimization
[/b]
Enemy Graphics Impact: I’ve optimized the graphical performance of enemies during nighttime battles, significantly improving frame rates, especially when hordes of foes flood the screen.
Memory Management: Enhanced memory release between scenes.

[b]Bug Fixes
[/b]
Level Restart Issue: Fixed a bug that prevented restarting the level from the pause or defeat menu.
Tutorial Completion: Resolved an issue that blocked some players from completing the tutorial.

I’m incredibly grateful for your feedback, which keep pushing me to make the game better every day. Got thoughts on what feels unbalanced or ideas for improvement? Share them in the Steam Discussion Forums! 

Thank you for your patience and support, more exciting updates are coming soon! 

Ivan

notes.title: Kingdom's Deck - v1.0.1 - Bug Fix & Balance & Performance Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Lords and Ladies![/b]

I’ve been diving into your feedback and bug reports on the Steam Discussion Forums, and I’m back with a quick patch to keep the adventure running smoothly. Thank you for your amazing support and insights!

[b]Game Balance[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Nighttime Challenge:[/b] The final night is now tougher in Standard and Conqueror modes, adding more intensity to the battle.
[*][b]Conqueror Mode Enemies:[/b] Foes in Conqueror mode now have slightly increased health and damage.
[*][b]Barracks Limit:[/b] Barracks are now capped at producing 5 soldiers per day.
[*][b]Rebuilding Speed:[/b] Reconstruction of buildings destroyed during the night is now faster, helping you recover quickly.
[/list]
[b]Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*][b]AMD Graphics Fix:[/b] I’ve fixed a crash issue affecting certain AMD graphics cards.
[*][b]Shadow Performance:[/b] Game shadows are now optimized for smoother performance.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Market:[/b] Fixed an error that caused negative resources in the market.
[*][b]Blacksmith & Armorer Bug:[/b] Fixed an issue where the game would pause in the evening until the battle started.
[*][b]Resolution Settings:[/b] Resolved a bug that reset the resolution in the settings menu whenever other changes were made.
[*][b]Tutorial Progression:[/b] Fixed an error that prevented players from advancing through the tutorial.
[/list]
I am committed to fine-tuning the experience based on your feedback. Got thoughts on what feels unbalanced or ideas for improvement? Share them in the Steam Discussion Forums! 

Thank you for your patience and support, more exciting updates are coming soon.

Ivan

notes.title: Kingdom's Deck is Out Now! 🎉
notes.content:
Greetings, Lords and Ladies!

We did it! Kingdoms Deck is officially OUT on Steam, and I’m thrilled to share this moment with you!

Nearly two years ago, I took a leap of faith, diving into my first commercial game with just my savings and a whole lot of hope. Kingdoms Deck began as a solo passion project, but over time it transformed into something truly special. I want to thank the amazing Rogue Duck team for their talent and dedication in shaping this game, and my family and friends for their unwavering support through every step!

But my biggest thanks go to YOU, our incredible community. Your feedback, videos, and messages (sometimes so many I could barely keep up!) shaped this game into what it is. I read every comment and watched countless videos. Your feedback has greatly improved this game.

Kingdoms Deck is a piece of my soul, crafted with love and care. I hope you enjoy the experience as you build your kingdom!

Ivan

notes.title: Plans for the Full Release!
notes.content:
Hi Lords and Ladies!

First of all, thank you for playing Kingdom’s Deck and for sharing your valuable feedback through the feedback form. Your input is helping shape the game, and I’m excited to reveal some of the amazing new features coming in the full release!

[h3]New Cards, New Strategies
[/h3]Get ready to expand your tactical options! You can expect new buildings, powerful spells, and game-changing tools. Some cards will provide resource boosts, while others will require you to take calculated risks, like trading resources for short-term advantages or using spells with thrilling, unpredictable outcomes. 

[h3]Unique Units and Fierce Enemies
[/h3]The battlefield is about to get even more exciting! I’m adding unique units to your army, each with their own strengths and abilities, offering more variety in combat. Whether you're deploying ranged attackers or heavy melee soldiers, every unit will play a critical role in your defense. But beware: new and terrifying enemies are on the way, bringing more intense battles that will challenge your strategies. The war for your kingdom will be tougher than ever, but with new allies at your side, you’ll be ready for anything!

[h3]New Scenarios and Game Modes
[/h3]Prepare to defend your kingdom across brand-new scenarios and maps! These new locations will introduce different enemy attack routes, requiring you to adapt to new environments and tactics. Whether it’s defending a narrow pass or protecting multiple fronts, these scenarios will test your strategic skills. Additionally, new difficulty levels and game modes will be added, how long can you hold out against waves of increasingly tougher enemies?

[h3]Improved Controls and Quality of Life Enhancements[/h3]
We’ve heard your feedback on unit management, and we’re making improvements! Expect smoother controls for better troop management and enhanced UI for greater clarity and readability throughout the game.

[h3]Balancing and Level Design
[/h3]One of my top priorities is ensuring that the game’s progression feels fair but challenging. We’re refining the pacing of both daytime building and nighttime battles to eliminate sudden difficulty spikes and smooth out the learning curve. Levels will be more balanced, providing a better flow as you advance, ensuring that each victory feels well-earned and satisfying.

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, your feedback continues to shape the future of Kingdom’s Deck. Don’t forget to wishlist the game—it really helps the development!

Ivan

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Strategy Game Demos by Rogue Duck!
notes.content:
During the Steam Next Fest, we have 4 free game demos up for you to try out. If you played a game published by Rogue Duck Interactive before, you probably love replayable strategy games!

Let me start introducing our games, during the Next Fest, download the demos you are interested and become part of the development by giving us your valueable feedback.

[h1]New Next Fest Strategy Demos[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2517440/Mini_City_Mayhem/

A city builder where you race against time to build your city! Become the mayor of a tiny town, plop down tiny building blocks to build a working city to progress.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3179860/Pairs__Perils/

A memory-game roguelike and dungeon crawler. Match cards to attack enemies, avoid traps, shop for relics and consumables. Sharpen your mind as you journey through the depths of the dungeon in search of The Dealer.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3056580/HEXAROMA_Village_Builder/

Build your charming medieval hexagon village in this city-builder. Strategize the best hexagon island placements. Place the building pieces strategically, and grow your village and your tiny island.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3204250/Lost_But_Found/

A combination of a job simulator & hidden object game. In a top-down table, you are an officer who oversees the lost items in an airport. Organize those items and distribute them to people who lost their belongings. 

That's all we have for this Next Fest, we hope you found something you like. In that case, wishlist the games to stay in the loop!


[h1]Other Strategy Demos[/h1]

Additionally, we have other demos, that's not participating in this edition of the Next Fest yet, but soon. Check them out too.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2449450/Clonizer/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2655590/Kingdoms_Deck/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2945950/Dice_n_Goblins/

Have a strategy-filled Next Fest event, everyone! Follow us on our social media so you don't miss free strategy goodies!
